text:
XL plants are still available to you, with a few differences from regular plants:

- **Delivery time:** XL plants (usually over 4 ft) ship Standard only, so you'd get the same **5-8 business days** as any other Zone 3 order. Express isn't available to you either way, so nothing changes there.
- **Extra fee:** There's a **$20 handling fee** on XL plants.
- **Shipping cost:** Standard shipping is $7.95, or free if your order is **$75 or more** (after discounts, before tax). I can't say whether the handling fee counts toward that $75 threshold, so I can't promise how it would apply to your order.
- **Shipping days:** Like all live plants, XL plants ship **Monday-Wednesday only**. Orders placed after 12 noon on Wednesday ship the following Monday.
- **Weather holds:** The same rules apply. If the transit forecast is below 35°F or above 95°F, your plant may be held for up to 7 days, and you'll be emailed.

If you tell me which plant you have in mind, I can help with anything else about ordering it. For plant-specific questions like size or care, a Plant Care Specialist can help by chat (9am-5pm Mon-Fri, your local time) or email.
